$comment: Serverless build guard. The root tsconfig.json uses moduleResolution 'bundler'
because Vite resolves extensionless imports at build time. That is correct for
the browser bundle and wrong for api/index.ts, which Vercel compiles to real ESM:
Node's ESM resolver does no extension guessing and no directory-index lookup, so
an extensionless import survives compilation and then throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
This config re-checks api/, server/ and scripts/ under NodeNext, which makes
'./db' and '../server/app' hard compile errors instead of runtime 500s.
